title: Aurora Lake
description: A living lake beneath close aurora curtains

title: Prismatic Sanctuary
description: A flowing jewel tunnel beneath a woven particle vault
music_direction: A single cohesive 90 BPM electronic arrangement: rounded low kick, soft offbeat bass, quiet filtered shaker, and sustained warm synth chords. No piano, plucked melody or independently timed backing music.

title: Fractal Garden
description: A sculpted kaleidoscope of evolving Mandelbrot fields
music_direction: Recursive glass harmonics in nested three- and six-note canons, beneath slowly unfolding harmonic fields.

title: Tidal Origami
description: Suspended liquid loops and breathing water petals
music_direction: Aquatic ambient: low singing bowls, muted marimba droplets, fluid glass resonances and deep rounded waterlike synth chords. Wide rippling acoustic space, no splash transients, long warm suspended waves.

title: Cloud Atelier
description: Layered cloud islands with a breathing vortex
music_direction: Weightless sustained string-like harmonics, airy vowel-free glass tones, long overlapping swells and no rhythmic percussion.

title: Neural Constellation
description: A deeper living network of converging signals
music_direction: Rounded cellular sine resonances answer across the stereo field over an evolving warm harmonic network.

title: Circuit Garden
description: Nested circuit assemblies with flowing charge
music_direction: Warm analogue oscillator chords and softly charged, slowly sequenced electronic tones. No acoustic instruments or percussion.

title: Pilgrim Tides
description: Braided processions and a gathering of lantern figures
music_direction: Humanist minimalist ambient: delicate felt piano, distant warm chamber strings, soft low clarinet, irregular slow call-and-response motifs, patient communal motion, consonant tender harmony. No marching pulse, no percussion, no vocals.

title: Visionary Temple
description: A painted tunnel of eyes, flames and mandalas opening into a temple
music_direction: A single deterministic 60 BPM psybient journey aligned to the sixteen-second breath: tanpura-like drone, sub-bass heartbeat, breath-shaped sixteenth-note plucked arpeggios, glass shimmer and wordless formant pads, moving through four harmonic passages that mirror the tunnel.
